{"error_cause":"Incorrect Information Extraction","reason":"The report’s Final Diagnosis states the largest invasive focus is 1.9 cm, which meets T1 criteria. The model instead pulled a gross measurement of “3.5 cm” (mis-reading a line that actually clarifies the greatest invasive dimension is 1.5 cm) and ignored the explicit 1.9 cm size. Having extracted the wrong size, it classified the tumor as T2, so the failure is in fact extraction, not staging logic."}
